<div class="code-entry-header">
  <h3>Stochastic control with expected signatures</h3>
  <a class="repo-link" href="https://github.com/lucapelizzari/expected_signature_transforms">
    <i class="fa-brands fa-github"></i> Repository
  </a>
</div>

Implementation of the [expected signature formula via coordinate change](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.29534). An illustration solving the optimal tracking of fractional Brownian motion is presented.

:::

::: {.code-entry}

<div class="code-entry-header">
  <h3>Time-series learning with Volterra signatures</h3>
  <a class="repo-link" href="https://github.com/lucapelizzari/Volterra_signature_learning">
    <i class="fa-brands fa-github"></i> Repository
  </a>
</div>

Regression and classification experiments with real-world data and time-series features built from the [Volterra signature](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.04525). The code relies on the JAX-based Python package `tensordev`, see <a class="repo-link" href="https://github.com/hagerpa/tensordev"><i class="fa-brands fa-github"></i> tensordev</a>, which implements algorithms from the accompanying technical paper on [computational aspects of the Volterra signature](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18406).

:::

::: {.code-entry}

<div class="code-entry-header">
  <h3>Rough PDEs for European options and Greeks</h3>
  <a class="repo-link" href="https://github.com/lucapelizzari/European-options-and-Greeks-with-rough-PDEs">
    <i class="fa-brands fa-github"></i> Repository
  </a>
</div>

Code for pricing European options and computing Greeks in general local stochastic volatility models via a finite-difference implementation of the [rough PDE pricing method](https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.09216).

:::

::: {.code-entry}

<div class="code-entry-header">
  <h3>Optimal stopping with signatures</h3>
  <a class="repo-link" href="https://github.com/lucapelizzari/Optimal_Stopping_with_signatures">
    <i class="fa-brands fa-github"></i> Repository
  </a>
</div>

Implementation of [primal and dual algorithms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.03444) for solving non-Markovian optimal stopping problems with path signatures. The examples include stopping problems for fractional Brownian motion, American option pricing under rough-volatility models such as rough Bergomi and rough Heston, and extensions to [deep and kernel learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.06758).

:::

::: {.code-entry}

<div class="code-entry-header">
  <h3>Local regression with signatures</h3>
  <a class="repo-link" href="https://github.com/Davit1123/nw-signature">
    <i class="fa-brands fa-github"></i> Repository
  </a>
</div>

Local kernel regression and classification on path space using [signature-based distances](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.16728). The repository contains implementations for path-valued regression and classification tasks, including examples for time series, SDE learning, and path-dependent option pricing.

:::
